svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: rough notes become a PRD through the write-prd skill, pm-skills lint catches vague words and metrics without a baseline, the fixed PRD is sliced into stories with Given/When/Then criteria and reviewed, backlog items are scored by the RICE script and the result goes into a stakeholder update
svg.title: How product-management-skills works
svg.text: The agent writes and reasons; a script checks the wording and does the math

g.text: Rough input: meeting notes, tickets, a half-formed idea
write-prd drafts problem, users, metrics with baseline and date, non-goals
lint flags "fast", a metric with no baseline and a missing non-goals section
Fixed and checked again: a one-page PRD that passes
Sliced into thin vertical slices, each with Given/When/Then criteria
review-spec reads it as an engineer, a designer and an executive before work starts
prioritize writes RICE inputs and a reason for each; the script ranks them
Close calls are flagged, then a stakeholder update with status, risks and asks
